description: was a Star Dreadnought.]] A Star Dreadnought was a type of dreadnought. Some vessels classified as Star Dreadnoughts included the Subjugator-class heavy cruiser used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, as well as some Imperial Super Star Destroyers such as the Executor-class Star Dreadnought, and the Assertor-class Star Dreadnought, as well as First Order capital ships such as the Mega-class Star Dreadnought and the specialized Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought.
